# ankra_organisation_roles (Data Source)

Lists the roles the organisation can grant: the built-in roles first, in privilege order, then the custom roles by slug. Use a role's `slug` for `ankra_service_token.role_slug` or a member's role. Needs the `members.read` permission.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ankra_organisation_roles" "all" {}

output "custom_role_slugs" {
  value = [for role in data.ankra_organisation_roles.all.roles : role.slug if !role.builtin]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Placeholder identifier for the data source.
- `roles` (Attributes List) Roles of the organisation. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--roles))

<a id="nestedatt--roles"></a>
### Nested Schema for `roles`

Read-Only:

- `builtin` (Boolean) Whether the role is built in.
- `description` (String) Description of the role; empty when none.
- `id` (String) Identifier of a custom role; null for a built-in role.
- `name` (String) Display name of the role.
- `permissions` (List of String) Permissions the role grants.
- `slug` (String) Slug of the role.
